_comment: IP-Adapter FaceID (SDXL) identity-preservation workflow (ComfyUI API format). Used ONLY when the ComfyUI_IPAdapter_plus (FaceID) nodes + models are installed — identity_manager detects this and the engine falls back to insightface face-lock otherwise, so nothing here is ever hardcoded into Python or required to run. Reference face -> face detection + embedding (IPAdapterUnifiedLoaderFaceID/insightface) -> IPAdapterFaceID conditions the SDXL model -> the target image is used as the init latent (so hair/clothing/background/pose are kept) -> KSampler regenerates with the reference identity -> decode -> save. backend/comfy_identity.py injects values by node id (checkpoint, reference_image, target_image, ipadapter_faceid.weight). To switch to InstantID instead, drop in an InstantID graph here with the same node ids; the engine and manager need no changes.

inputs.text: a person, same identity, photorealistic, sharp detail
different person, deformed, blurry, lowres, distorted, artifacts, watermark, text
